visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with platinum blonde hair and a pink flower hair clip is centered in the frame against a soft, bright indoor background. She wears a white t-shirt and speaks directly to the camera while holding a brown brow pencil and a beige mascara-like tube. Her expressions are lively, with frequent smiles and direct eye contact. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a hand holding a small beige tube with the brand name 'Laka' printed on it. The background is blurred, focusing entirely on the product packaging. (3) The scene shifts back to the woman who now demonstrates the product's brush; it is very fine and thin. She swatches the light brown gel on the back of her wrist to show the texture and color. (4) The woman begins applying the brow mascara to her left eyebrow. She uses short, controlled strokes, first brushing with the grain of the hair and then against it to ensure full coverage. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the change in her eyebrow color. (5) A comparison shot is shown where one eyebrow is noticeably lighter and more groomed than the other, which remains darker and less defined. She points to her eyebrows to emphasize the difference. (6) She introduces a second product, a thin brow liquid pencil from 'ettusais'. She swatches this on her wrist as well, showing thin, hair-like strokes. (7) She applies the liquid pencil to the front of her eyebrow to create a 'hair-stroke' effect, then refines the tail of the brow for a sharper finish. (8) A montage shows her completing the other eyebrow using the same two-step process. (9) Finally, she lowers her bangs to show the completed look, holding both products next to her face and smiling warmly at the camera.
